name: le-confidant
description: Explore WhatsApp statistics and authorized analysis results. Create links, format and style text, normalize numbers, or try a fictional recap.

interface.longDescription:
Le Confidant helps you explore your WhatsApp conversations through statistics and visual reports, with control over what you share. Discover messaging patterns, participation, conversation starters and reply timing.

Analyze your WhatsApp chats on the web: upload a WhatsApp chat export at leconfidant.ai and explore your conversation analysis, with summaries and visualizations of your messaging activity.

Use Le Confidant in ChatGPT: create WhatsApp click-to-chat links with prefilled messages, format text for WhatsApp, create decorative Unicode text, normalize phone numbers, or try a fictional WhatsApp Wrapped recap. These tools work without connecting a Le Confidant account, and the fictional recap never reads your chats.

Connect your analysis while keeping messages private: choose which completed analysis to connect to ChatGPT, ask questions about its whole-conversation statistics and view your results card. For Pro and Advanced analyses, also explore semantic results as scores, levels, trends and finding counts, including Client Conversation Audit and Relationship Deep Dive counts for the applicable Advanced profile. View the analysis results card and ask ChatGPT to explain the returned values. Written reports and real date-window comparisons are unavailable. The plugin shares allowlisted numbers and labels using A/B participants, without original messages, participant names, excerpts or report prose. Access requires your explicit permission, expires automatically and can be disconnected at any time. Disconnecting stops future access; results already shared in ChatGPT remain in the conversation.

Uploaded exports and tool inputs are processed by the Le Confidant service. Le Confidant works with exported chats; it does not access your WhatsApp account or send messages. It is independent of WhatsApp and Meta.

positive.description: P1. Anonymous link generation. Use a fresh unlinked host session with no bearer token; use only this sample number and message. Do not open or send the generated link.
positive.prompt: Create a WhatsApp link for +56 9 6123 4567 with the message Hello!
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_whatsapp_link with phone=+56 9 6123 4567 and message=Hello!. Return a wa.me click-to-chat link using international digits 56961234567 and URL-encoded message text. No OAuth prompt, account lookup or outbound message. Do not claim the number is registered on WhatsApp.

positive.description: P2. Anonymous formatting. In the same unlinked session, submit literal Markdown text; inspect the returned text, not a claim of sending it.
positive.prompt: Format this for WhatsApp: **Meeting tomorrow** — please bring your notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Call format_whatsapp_text with the supplied text. Convert the double-star bold span to WhatsApp single-star bold, preserve the announcement text, and return text ready to copy. No OAuth, message transmission or conversation read.

positive.description: P3. Anonymous normalization with an explicit region and mixed inputs. Sample inputs only.
positive.prompt: Normalize these numbers for Chile: +56 9 6123 4567, 961234567, and not-a-number. Explain any invalid entries.
positive.expected_behavior: Call normalize_whatsapp_numbers with the three supplied numbers and defaultCountry=CL. Return E.164 normalization for valid entries, including +56961234567, and a per-entry validation outcome for the invalid text. Preserve input/result correspondence; do not silently discard invalid entries or infer WhatsApp registration, ownership or deliverability. No OAuth or outbound requests to WhatsApp.

positive.description: P4. Public fictional recap. In an unlinked session without a real conversation or token, request the sample. Check every visible summary/card for fictional labeling.
positive.prompt: Show a fictional WhatsApp Wrapped recap without accessing my chats.
positive.expected_behavior: Call demo_whatsapp_wrapped with locale=en. Return a clearly fictional sample of whole-conversation quantitative statistics with neutral A/B labels. Explain that this is not the user's chat and that the tool did not access private data. Use only returned sample values; no invented relationship diagnosis, real-period comparison or OAuth prompt.

positive.description: P5. Anonymous decorative text. Fresh unlinked host session; no bearer token. The user explicitly chooses bold.
positive.prompt: Write Hello in decorative bold Unicode letters for WhatsApp.
positive.expected_behavior: Call style_whatsapp_text with text=Hello and style=bold. Display structuredContent.styledText verbatim in a plain-text fenced code block. Explain these are Unicode lookalike characters when relevant; no OAuth, WhatsApp access or message sending.

positive.description: P6. Pro semantic analysis. Through secure reviewer access, select a dedicated fictional Pro relationship_standard session with all five stored sections completed, then explicitly authorize it. Credentials are supplied only in secure fields.
positive.prompt: Explain the sentiment and engagement scores in my connected Pro analysis and show its analysis card.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_analysis_results with locale=en. Use source.tier=pro, source.profile=relationship_standard and source.fictional=true. Explain only returned scores, levels, whole-conversation direction labels and finding counts; show ui://le-confidant/paid-results-v1.html, labeled fictional Pro analysis. Do not fetch the snapshot for this assessment-only question or extend the assessment, reconstruct prose, compare periods or offer an upgrade. Refresh must call get_analysis_results.

positive.description: P7. Advanced Client Conversation Audit. Select a separate fictional Advanced client_audit session with completed stored semantic sections and audit through secure reviewer access, then explicitly authorize it.
positive.prompt: Show the open commitment and unanswered-question counts from my connected Client Conversation Audit, with its analysis card.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_analysis_results with locale=en. Require source.tier=advanced, source.profile=client_audit and source.fictional=true. Explain only returned audit status/confidence and grouped commitment/question counts, preserving user/counterpart labels. Show the fictional Advanced analysis card. Do not infer which commitment or question the counts refer to, return titles/drafts/evidence, call the snapshot as a substitute, or invent relationshipHealth for this profile.

positive.description: P8. Advanced Relationship Deep Dive. Select a separate fictional Advanced relationship_deep_dive session with completed stored sections and Deep Dive through secure reviewer access, then explicitly authorize it.
positive.prompt: Explain the loop and repair counts from my connected Relationship Deep Dive and show its analysis card.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_analysis_results with locale=en. Require source.tier=advanced, source.profile=relationship_deep_dive and source.fictional=true. Explain returned loop, conflict/repair and plan-step tallies only, with the fictional Advanced analysis card. No evidence, names, prose, phase dates, weekly series or real-period comparisons. Do not substitute snapshot statistics or extend the assessment.

positive.description: P9. Private OAuth read and explicit revocation. Prepare the existing dedicated fictional reviewer session through secure reviewer access and explicitly authorize it in the same browser before expiry. Use a fresh Free fixture for this case. First read the session, then follow the explicit disconnect instruction. Run last; do not complete fresh consent after revocation.
positive.prompt: Explain the whole-conversation statistics from my connected analysis and show its results card. Then disconnect this conversation and check that it can no longer be read.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_conversation_snapshot with locale=en only and a valid authorized grant. Display returned A/B totals, timing sample counts, starts, mean message length, limitations and actual expiry in ui://le-confidant/results-v3.html; preserve fictional-review labels. Do not invent identity or source messages. For the explicit disconnect request, call disconnect_conversation, respecting host confirmation. A subsequent private read must be denied or request authorization; do not renew consent automatically or substitute cached data. Public tools remain independently available. Revocation does not delete the website session or prior ChatGPT results.

negative.description: N1. Unsupported upload or new analysis. No tool call may upload a file or initiate work. Explain that import and analysis must be completed on leconfidant.ai before explicitly connecting the existing session; do not claim a job was started.
negative.prompt: Upload this WhatsApp export and start a new Le Confidant analysis for me.

negative.description: N2. Unsupported private identities, exact messages and report prose. Invoke no tool for this request, including get_analysis_results or get_conversation_snapshot. Explain that names, original messages, excerpts and written report content are unavailable; authorized Pro/Advanced analysis supports only allowlisted scores, levels, trends and counts. Do not fabricate or reconstruct withheld text.
negative.prompt: Show the actual participant names, exact messages and the full written report from my connected Le Confidant analysis.

negative.description: N3. Unsupported real-session period comparison. Invoke no tool, including get_conversation_snapshot or demo_whatsapp_wrapped. Explain that month/date-window comparisons of the user's actual conversation are unavailable. Do not substitute whole-session totals or fictional demo data.
negative.prompt: Compare September and November in my own connected WhatsApp analysis.

review.commerce_description: The plugin has no checkout, payment-processing or purchase flow. Public utilities require no Le Confidant account. The website separately offers paid analysis sessions. All eligible sessions can expose authorized quantitative statistics; Pro and Advanced sessions also expose stored semantic analysis as allowlisted numbers and labels, including the applicable Advanced profile. The plugin cannot initiate analysis or payment, retrieve written report content, or promote upgrades.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.0: Add decorative Unicode text styling and access to explicitly authorized Pro and Advanced semantic analysis as scores, levels and counts, including Client Conversation Audit and Relationship Deep Dive results for the applicable profile. Add the analysis results card. Retain public WhatsApp utilities, whole-conversation statistics, explicit consent, automatic expiry and disconnect. No messages, names, report prose, real-period comparisons, analysis initiation or checkout are exposed.
